description: analyze_msd on hand-built frames with exact answers: uniform shift (1,2,2) gives 9 A^2; static atoms with swapped type labels give 0; one atom crossing the periodic x face (9.5 -> 0.5 in a 10 A box) gives 1. Variable box: x length 10 -> 12 -> 8 with x 9.5 -> 0.5 -> 6.5 gives MSD [0, 9, 1] under the documented current-frame-length MIC (a first-frame-length implementation would give [0, 1, 9]).
source: Analytic squared displacements. Time axis: dt_fs = 2 and a 100-step gap is 0.2 ps.

sources.variable_box_msd: Pins the current-frame-length MIC convention of analyze_msd. Not evidence of physical diffusion accuracy; if unwrapping moves to fractional coordinates or dump unwrapped columns, this expected value must be revised.
